scripts.build: pnpm -C ../../packages/workflow-sdk build && node scripts/sync-runtime-assets.mjs && vite build && node scripts/sync-runtime-assets.mjs --dist
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.dev: pnpm -C ../../packages/workflow-sdk build && node scripts/sync-runtime-assets.mjs && cross-env ISAGI_DATA_DIR=../../data/.isagi ISAGI_RUNTIME_DEBUG=1 tsx src/index.ts
scripts.dev:fixed: pnpm -C ../../packages/workflow-sdk build && node scripts/sync-runtime-assets.mjs && cross-env ISAGI_DATA_DIR=../../data/.isagi ISAGI_RUNTIME_DEBUG=1 PORT=17373 tsx src/index.ts
scripts.test: pnpm -C ../../packages/workflow-sdk build && node scripts/sync-runtime-assets.mjs && node --import tsx --test --experimental-test-isolation=none --test-force-exit "src/**/*.test.ts"
